summary: postinstall exfiltrates JWT-shaped environment variables to hardcoded ngrok tunnel
details: The package's package.json postinstall lifecycle script runs an inline Node one-liner that enumerates every entry of process.env, matches values against a JWT-shaped regex (/ey[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\./), and POSTs any matches to the hardcoded host crabbing-thong-overhung.ngrok-free.dev at path /jwt via http.request. The destination is an anonymous ngrok tunnel with no relationship to any documented first-party service, and the harvesting fires automatically on npm install with no user interaction. This is bulk installer-side credential theft at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
